title: Japan 5-Year JGB auction — the second arm of the BoJ's deepest-tapered region (3-5y, -62.3%) and the tenor whose issuance MOF has not moved at all (±0.0% since 2024)
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,187 bytes) by the jgb-10y-auction-2026-11-05 initial research; parsed cell by cell, its table row reads 'Nov. 12, 2026 | 5-year'. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED: no November row carries an 'Auction Announcement' href on 2026-09-09, `2612e.htm` 404s, and MOF's note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date' — which at the 10-year measured as exactly seven days three times running, putting these terms around 2026-11-05. ¥2,500bn is the anticipated base case from MOF's Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, 492,032 bytes, last saved 2026-08-13, parsed 2026-09-09), whose 5年債 sheet shows ¥2,500bn at 2024-01-16, ¥2,300bn from 2024-04-09, ¥2,400bn from 2025-04-10 and ¥2,500bn from 2026-01-14 — a round trip, net ±0.0% over the window. Issue identity is MOF-stated but not yet for this row: 2608e.htm and 2609e.htm print '5-year(187)' for 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-08, while the October and November rows carry no number because they have not settled. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the jgb-10y-auction-2026-11-05 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) on MOF's own November calendar; it sits D+7 from the proposing event — outside the ±5-day corridor, and proposed on evidence rather than on proximity. IT IS PROPOSED FOR ONE MEASURED REASON, AND THE PROPOSING LEDGER'S CENTRAL RESULT IS WHAT MOTIVATES IT. That session read the BoJ's purchase path from 32 monthly operation workbooks and found the taper's dose ordering INVERTED against auction quality: tail share >=2bp from 2007-2023 to 2024+ runs 2Y 0.5%->0.0% (1-3y bucket, -52.7%), 5Y 1.5%->0.0% (3-5y, -62.3%), 10Y 3.4%->19.4% (5-10y, -64.8%), 20Y 4.4%->32.3% (10-25y, -55.4%), 30Y 4.7%->19.4% (25y+, -0.2%). The 5-year is the sharpest control that exists for the 10-year: its bucket took nearly the same dose (-62.3% vs -64.8%), its issuance moved LESS than the 10-year's (±0.0% vs -3.7%), and it is auctioned seven days later in the same month — so a cross-sectional comparison between them separates 'the 10-year is damaged because its bucket was tapered' from 'the 10-year is damaged because it carries ten years of duration in a market that repriced from 0% to 2.9%'. No super-long leg can do that job: MOF's own -30% to -57% super-long issuance cuts confound every comparison in that direction, which is exactly why the 40-year was retired as a control and why the 10-year's own control rationale inverted. THE HONEST LIMIT ON THAT RATIONALE, STATED UP FRONT: the comparison is cross-sectional and observational, and the proposing ledger already measured that no TIME-SERIES dose test is identified at any tenor (net supply to private hands correlates with calendar time at r = +0.990, t = +38.7, n=32), so this event cannot rescue the regression — it can only add a second point to a five-tenor cross-section that already refutes the dose ordering. If its initial research finds the 5-year's quiet record is a duration artifact rather than a dose result, the control value weakens rather than disappears. The registered prediction it would score is FT-jgb-10y-auction-2026-11-05-2, whose stated prior is a ~95%+ pass, i.e. only a failure is informative. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reasons all sibling JGB ledgers record: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
